profiling_note: Deterministic output. No wall-clock timestamps. Loaded with restricted unpickler; allowed classes: numpy.core.multiarray._reconstruct, numpy.ndarray, numpy.dtype.
readme_files_in_archive: None. No readme or documentation files were present in archive_DEAP.zip. Channel order and sampling rate sourced from Koelstra et al. (2012).
timestamps_note: No timestamp arrays are embedded in the .dat files. Signals are contiguous sample arrays at a uniform rate (128 Hz). All signals in one participant file share one sample clock (single device time base). No cross-device alignment is needed within a participant.
units_note: Units are NOT stated in any file in this archive. Based on the DEAP paper and readme (not present in this mirror): EEG channels are in microvolts (uV) after preprocessing; peripheral channel units are as follows -- GSR: Ohm (inverted conductance; note: may need conversion to uS); Respiration: amplitude (dimensionless, belt tension); BVP: amplitude (dimensionless, photoplethysmograph); Temperature: degrees Celsius. These units require verification against the official DEAP readme before physiological bounds can be set.
